official.title: TU Delft MXR Lab is recruiting at PhD and postdoc level simultaneously (4 concurrent openings)
official.excerpt: Verified from four concurrent official postings (July 2026): PhD XR for Inclusive AV Interaction (req 1366984057, deadline 2026-08-30); PhD XR for Safe & Active Mobility / SAFE MOVE (req 1363878257, deadline 2026-07-19); Postdoc XR Inclusive AV Interaction (req 1366984557, deadline 2026-08-30); PhD Data & AI Micromobility Safety / SAFE MOVE (req 1363882157, deadline 2026-07-19). All in the Mobility in eXtended Reality Lab, Dept. of Transport & Planning, CEG.

manual.notes: TAG: lab-expansion / future-recruitment-monitoring. A funded, growing XR-behaviour lab at a priority-1 target. One contact (Dr. Yan Feng) covers both XR PhD openings.
